name: Warp Surge
description: Focal zoom-streak treatment for push-through transitions, beat drops, and energetic scene entrances.
author: ozonerepublic74d77777

parameters.name: Amount
parameters.description: Controls the total focal displacement in pixels.

parameters.name: Focal Point
parameters.description: Sets the point toward which the frame surges or from which it pulls away.

parameters.name: Streak Length
parameters.description: Controls the length of the radial blur trail along the surge direction.

parameters.name: Samples
parameters.description: Sets the number of radial samples used to form the streak.

parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description: Chooses between an inward surge and an outward pull.

parameters.name: Progress
parameters.description: Drives the effect from its starting state to its full transition state.

parameters.name: Ease
parameters.description: Shapes how quickly the surge reaches its full strength.

parameters.name: Wrap Edges
parameters.description: Wraps samples around the frame edges when enabled instead of clamping them.
